original_product_snapshot.name: handmade SOAP
original_product_snapshot.description:
Handmade cold process soap. Approximately 5oz each. Made with vegetable oils like olive, coconut, soybean and sunflower and enriched with shea butter and vitamin E. Luxurious lather and aromas. 

calm:: Lavender essential oil. Lavender offers an intoxicating and therapeutic presence with its full-bodied, earthy aroma.

charcoal tea tree:: Essential oil blend of peppermint and tea tree, activated charcoal. Activated charcoal is said to draw impurities, dirt and oil from the skin.

cherry almond:: classic blend of sweet cherries and nutty almond with a touch of cherry blossom.

coffee bean:: fresh roasted coffee beans drizzled with hazelnut syrup. Includes goat's milk for a creamy, moisturizing lather.

deep sea:: Icy notes of peppermint and menthol along with musky notes of a warm amber and bourbon. Rich avocado oil will add back moisture which helps balance out the exfoliating pumice and bentonite clay that gives this soap it's characteristic grit.

eucalyptus spearmint:: Eucalyptus globulus essential oil and spearmint essential oil combine the cool crisp scent of eucalyptus with the sweet, minty aroma of spearmint.

flower power:: Patchouli essential oil, geranium essential oil.

himalayan salt:: unscented. oils of olive, sustainable palm* & coconut, shea butter, Himalayan salt, sea salt. 

lavender oats:: Goat Milk, Lavender Essential Oil, Oatmeal.

lavender patchouli:: Goat Milk, Lavender Essential Oil, Patchouli Essential Oil.

nag champa:: blend of plumeria, asian resins and sandalwood to bring out your inner hippie. 

naked:: unscented. Ingredients: saponified oils of olive, coconut*, shea butter, palm*, soybean*, vitamin e. 

oatmeal & honey:: Goat Milk, Oatmeal, Honey.

orange patchouli:: Orange Essential Oil, Patchouli Essential Oil, Black Walnut Powder. Unique aroma of rich sweet orange coupled with earthy rich patchouli and cedarwood.

patchouli:: Shea butter, patchouli essential oil, kaolin clay, iron oxide, vitamin e.

personal defense:: Lemon Essential Oil, Eucalyptus Globulus Essential Oil, Rosemary Essential Oil, Clove Essential Oil, Cinnamon Essential Oil, Kaolin Clay, Rhassoul Clay, Activated Charcoal.

raspberry lemonade:: sweet raspberries and tart lemonade for this soft, almost nostalgic scent perfect for spring and summer.

tea tree:: Tea Tree Essential Oil and Parsley Powder.

tea tree mint::  Peppermint Essential Oil, Tea Tree Essential Oil, Parsley Powder, Peppermint Leaves.

wedded bliss:: Notes of Strawberries, Champagne, and Cassia. Poppy Seeds, Illite Clay, Kaolin Clay.

white tea & ginger:: Classy and elevated this fresh, clean scent contains notes of Bergamot and Grapefruit, as well as Ginger, and a hint of florals.

woodlands:: Lemongrass Essential Oil, Cedarwood Essential Oil, Orange Essential Oil, Clary Sage Essential Oil, Rosehip Powder.
